title: Consumer cluster.yaml — declarative cluster Source-of-Truth
description: Shape of a consumer cluster.yaml (see cluster.yaml.example). Mirrors the tofu/modules/talos-cluster variable validations for the structured surface (images / hardware-capabilities / nodes / identity / versions). The free-form Talos config_patches and the per-tool substrate.*.values_override passthroughs are deliberately NOT content-validated here: structural validity of patch content is Talos' concern at apply time, and any secret-leak risk in them is gitleaks' (AGENTS.md §Tool-Agnostic Safety Invariants), not this schema's. Secrets (sops_age_key, cilium_ipsec_key) have no schema slot by design. A reserved hardware-feature.* label forged inside a free-form config_patches block is the downstream-Kyverno boundary, not a schema concern.
$comment: No schema_version field by design: cluster.yaml carries none, and the schema is versioned by its $id + the base OCI tag (a breaking shape change bumps the next tag's MAJOR per AGENTS.md/CHANGELOG). Migration signal = OCI tag, not an in-file version.

name.description: Talos cluster name (PKI CN) and ArgoCD Application/Project name. Lowercase RFC-1123 label.

endpoint.description: Kubernetes API endpoint, an https:// URL including the port.

overlay.description: kustomize overlay NAME (a single directory name under kubernetes/overlays/, not a path) read by task bootstrap:argocd. Pattern-bound to a DNS-1123-style label: it is interpolated into the root Application's spec.source.path, so a value like '..' or '../..' would point a prune+selfHeal Application at a parent directory. Same alphabet as cluster.name.

target_revision.description: git branch/tag for the ArgoCD root Application (read by task bootstrap:argocd).

pod_cidr.description: Pod network CIDR(s). One entry single-stack; v4+v6 when dual_stack.

register_with_fqdn.description: Set machine.kubelet.registerWithFQDN so the kubelet registers with the node's FQDN instead of its short hostname. Talos splits a dotted hostname at the first dot and registers only the SHORT hostname by default, so a dotted node key is meaningless to Kubernetes unless this is true — and the module rejects dotted node keys while it is false. ALL-OR-NOTHING: one dotted node key flips FQDN registration for every node in the cluster. Default false.

url.description: Consumer cluster repo URL (read by task bootstrap:argocd).

version.description: Talos machine-config schema pin — v-prefixed semver (optional pre-release/build suffix), fixed at bootstrap.

install_version.description: Installer-image tag for OS upgrades. Empty = matches talos.version.

version.description: Kubernetes version — v-prefixed semver (optional pre-release/build suffix).

images.description: Per-image installer base. Key = image id referenced by node.image.

hardware-capabilities.description: Composable, tool-agnostic node capabilities. Key = capability id referenced by node.hardware_capabilities. May be empty.

nodes.description: Bare-metal cluster members, keyed by node name. The KEY is the node's Talos hostname and its Kubernetes node name — one node, one definition place, so declaring the same node twice is structurally impossible. Keys must ALREADY be canonical Kubernetes node names: Talos validates hostname LENGTH only and silently rewrites the rest (lowercasing, '_' -> '-', dropping other characters), so a non-canonical key would arrive in the cluster under a different name than the one declared here. The per-label 63-character bound is not expressible in JSON Schema without a lookahead; the tofu module enforces it and is the gate that actually blocks an apply.

config_patches.description: Cluster-wide Talos machine-config patches (free-form YAML maps).

controlplane_config_patches.description: Controlplane-only Talos machine-config patches (free-form YAML maps).

worker_config_patches.description: Worker-only Talos machine-config patches (free-form YAML maps).

substrate.description: Layer-1 substrate delivery. Cilium, ArgoCD and cert-approver are the cluster.yaml-configurable substrate tools — the consumer yamldecode shim reads substrate.cilium, substrate.argocd and substrate.cert_approver. cert-approver is always-on substrate (a controlplane inlineManifest seed, adr-0019 supersedes adr-0013 §D2); its substrate.cert_approver keys tune the SAN-to-node binding + replicas but cannot disable the seed. Closed (additionalProperties:false) so a typo'd sibling key (e.g. argo_cd:) is caught at lint time instead of being silently dropped by the shim. The per-tool inner long tail (values_override, encryption, …) stays loosely typed. A future configurable substrate tool ships a schema update in the same base OCI tag.

cilium.description: Cilium CNI delivery + first-class observability inputs (default off) + opt-in ArgoCD self-management delivery mode (default off, module-emitted Application output only). Closed (additionalProperties:false) so a typo'd key is caught at lint time instead of being silently dropped. See knowledge/decisions/0022-cilium-observability-and-argocd-self-management.md.

enabled.description: Deliver Cilium as a controlplane inlineManifest seed. false keeps the Talos-default CNI (Flannel) or a caller-supplied CNI.

chart_version.description: cilium Helm chart version. SEED knob (install-time), not an upgrade knob.

chart_repository.description: Helm repository for the cilium chart. No digest/cosign pin — point only at a trusted source.

routing_mode.description: Cilium datapath routing mode: tunnel (VXLAN/Geneve overlay) or native (routed fabric, e.g. BGP). Install-time-fixed.

kube_proxy_replacement.description: Run Cilium as the kube-proxy replacement (also sets Talos cluster.proxy.disabled). Install-time-fixed.

gateway_api.description: Enable the Cilium Gateway API controller. Hard Constraint: Gateway API only, no Ingress.

gateway_api_crds_url.description: OPT-IN bootstrap seeding of the Gateway API CRDs via cluster.extraManifests. Empty = CRDs are a Day-1 GitOps concern. No digest pin — a failed fetch crashloops Talos bootstrap.

native_routing_cidr.description: ipv4NativeRoutingCIDR for routing_mode: native. Empty = derive from the first pod_cidr entry. The chart renders this raw into cilium-config, which is baked into the machine config, so the value is format-validated on both paths.

allOf.$comment: Lexical mirror of variables.tf var.cilium_native_routing_cidr, whose guard is the semantic predicate can(cidrhost(...)) — not expressible in JSON Schema. This admits the CIDR SHAPE only; the module keeps the precise verdict. Empty stays legal (derive from pod_cidr).
Engine divergence, closed explicitly — same reason as agent_metric_overrides below: Python re matches $ before a trailing newline, RE2 does not.

encryption.description: Transparent pod-traffic encryption: { type: none|wireguard|ipsec }. ipsec requires cilium_ipsec_key via tfvar/env. Inner long tail stays loosely typed.

values_override.description: Long-tail consumer Helm values merged on the floor + computed values (Hubble long tail beyond the first-class inputs below, L2/BGP announcements, bpf tuning). Feeds ONLY the bootstrap seed, never the self-management emitted Application (see self_management).

agent_metrics.description: Enable Cilium agent Prometheus metrics (prometheus.enabled). Default off.

operator_metrics.description: Enable Cilium operator Prometheus metrics (operator.prometheus.enabled). Default off.

hubble_enabled.description: Enable Hubble for flow/metrics observability. Forces hubble.tls.enabled=false (observer-API server TLS off, metrics-only scope — the Hubble metrics endpoint is independent of observer TLS since Cilium 1.16). Default off.

hubble_metrics.description: Hubble metrics to export (hubble.metrics.enabled), e.g. ["dns","drop","tcp"] or the context form "flow:sourceContext=pod". Default []. Scrape wiring (ServiceMonitors/PodMonitors) stays consumer-side.

items.$comment: Mirrors variables.tf var.cilium_hubble_metrics. An EXCLUSION rule, not an allowlist: the legitimate context syntax uses ':', ';', '=' and ',' freely. Newline and '---' are the two measured corruption vectors — the chart renders these entries raw into cilium-config, which is baked into the machine config.

agent_metric_overrides.description: Agent metric DELTA list (prometheus.metrics): "+name" adds a metric to the chart's default set, "-name" removes one. Not a replacement of that set, and unrelated to values_override. The chart renders these raw into cilium-config, which is baked into the machine config. Default []. On an ALREADY-BOOTSTRAPPED cluster this reaches the cluster only via substrate.cilium.self_management (the seed render is frozen after first capture) or at the next fresh bootstrap. Warns when it cannot take effect.

allOf.$comment: Mirrors variables.tf var.cilium_agent_metric_overrides so the declarative path rejects a corrupting entry at lint time too, not only at plan time.

Engine divergence, closed explicitly: check-jsonschema evaluates `pattern` with Python re, where $ also matches before a trailing newline; OpenTofu's regex() is RE2, where it does not. Without this the two engines disagree on "+ok\n".

hubble_open_metrics.description: Export the Hubble metrics endpoint in OpenMetrics format (hubble.metrics.enableOpenMetrics). Changes only the cilium-config ConfigMap — no DaemonSet roll — so a running cluster keeps the old exposition format until `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart ds/cilium`. Default off. Requires a NON-EMPTY hubble_metrics: the chart gates the OpenMetrics key on the metrics list, so it is inert on an endpoint that exports nothing. Same seed-freeze caveat as agent_metric_overrides. Warns when it cannot take effect.

self_management.description: Opt-in: emit a Cilium ArgoCD Application (module output only, never applied by the module) as the Day-2 delivery path. HARD-REJECTED at plan time when values_override is non-empty (the emitted Application does not inherit it — see ADR-0022). Requires enabled=true and the ArgoCD substrate enabled. Default off.

self_management_project.description: ArgoCD AppProject the emitted Application targets. Default "default" (the always-present permissive project) — scope to a dedicated project with the required destination + clusterResourceWhitelist for hardening (see README).

cert_approver.description: postfinance/kubelet-csr-approver tuning (the seed itself is unconditional; these keys cannot disable it). Closed so a typo'd security-control key fails lint rather than silently falling back to the permissive default. SEED knobs (create-only inlineManifest): changes re-render the machine config but do NOT update a running approver — see UPGRADING.md.

provider_regex.description: Cluster-wide regex every kubelet-serving CSR's SAN DNS name must additionally match (the full DNS SAN, e.g. '^node-.*$', not the bare node name). Default '.*' (no extra constraint; the per-node HasPrefix DNS-SAN binding is always on regardless). Must contain a non-whitespace character — an empty PROVIDER_REGEX makes postfinance/kubelet-csr-approver v1.2.14 exit fatally, and a whitespace-only regex matches no DNS SAN (deny-all). Must not contain a YAML document separator (---) or newline — mirrors the module's var.cert_approver_provider_regex validation so the declarative path rejects it at lint time too.

provider_ip_prefixes.description: CIDR set every kubelet-serving CSR's SAN IP must fall within. Default ['0.0.0.0/0','::/0'] (all IPs). Must be non-empty — an empty set DENIES every CSR carrying an IP SAN. Tighten to node subnets for the IP-SAN-to-subnet binding.

replicas.description: cert-approver Deployment replica count. Default 1. Raise (e.g. 2) to opt into HA — replicas > 1 auto-enables leader-election + the coordination.k8s.io/leases RBAC.

architecture.description: Installer-image architecture. Defaults to amd64 in the module when omitted.

cpu_vendor.description: Resolves a profile's vendor variants (e.g. iommu intel vs amd). REQUIRED, no default.

extensions.description: Baseline Image-Factory system extensions baked on every node of this image.

extra_kernel_args.description: Extra kernel command-line arguments baked into this image's UKI via the Image-Factory schematic (customization.extraKernelArgs) — the UKI-correct sink; machine.install.extraKernelArgs is ignored under systemd-boot. Unioned with the node's resolved provisioning-profile args. One argument per element.

allOf.$comment: Rule W — mirrors variables.tf. The ASCII class is spelled out on purpose: the module side is RE2 [[:space:]] (ASCII-scoped), while a bare \s here is Unicode-aware, which would make the two sides diverge.
Rule D — the karg removal spelling is a Non-Goal; the module's conflict guard cannot see it.
Rule E — empty key. Rejects the bare empty string and a leading '=', both of which key as "" and defeat the guard's =-keying.
Rule B — the debugfs key at any value (AGENTS.md §Hard Constraints forbids the value that boot-loops Talos with Cilium).

overlay.description: ARM single-board-computer board overlay. Null/omitted for x86/metal nodes.

requires_features.description: Layer-C atom ids for scheduling / labels.

provisioning_profiles.description: Ids of base catalog profiles to apply (drbd, iommu, nvidia-lts, …). Explicit.

emits_label.description: Node label set when a node holds this capability. MUST be in the platform.io/hardware-capability.* namespace (reserved hardware-feature.* labels come only from a profile's provides).

ip.description: Unique node IP reachable on the Talos API port.

role.description: Kubernetes node role. Hardware specialisation is a capability, NOT a role.

image.description: Must be a key in images.

hardware_capabilities.description: Set of capability ids (keys in hardware-capabilities) this node holds.

config_patches.description: Per-node Talos machine-config patches (free-form YAML maps).
